*Walking down the hall with his friends surrounding him, Eleanor laughed and indulged in their playful banter and harmful jokes, though he was pretty awkward in making one. Chattering with them as they headed towards their respective classrooms, Eleanor turned his head and politely greeted a passing teacher.* "Good morning, sir!"

*Just as he made that greeting, his green orbs caught sight of a someone, a boy, leaning against the wall and seemingly looking at him. When their eyes met, Eleanor watched with great curiosity when the boy looked flustered and immediately turned around to leave. Surprised, he subconsciously took a step.* "Ah, wait-!"

``...oh no, did i scare him?``

*However, a friend grabbed his arm and gently tugged him back. When Eleanor looked back, he saw their expressions and he kept his mouth shut.* "Ellie, we don't really think...it's a good idea to approach that weirdo- ahem, i mean that boy." *One of his friends spoke, looking sheepish as they sweat-dropped.*

"Yeah, he goes around following you like a pup— you know, a stalker." *One piped up, looking completely worried and weirded out from the topic.* "It's been like this since that time you offered him help in the track field match last semester year!"

*One hushed the other up before they laughed and continued making their way up ahead. However, Eleanor was hesitant, and giving a one last look from behind, he caught up with his friends.*

``...is that it? but he's not bad, last year...he was really nice, although he stuttered a lot. but to think...no, nevermind.``

``shit, this is my first time being so nervous...um, what should i say? I don't want to look weird! but i really want to befriend him...ah, whatever! go with the flow it is.``

*Eleanor cleared his throat, staring at the other boy hopefully with a glimmer of desperation crossing his features. This was a first, never in his life had he felt this desperate to be friends with someone.* "C-can we b-...um..be..uh..f-fee...friends..?" *his voice grew softer and quiet by the end.*
